text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired -> service="inference-prod" priority=P1 trigger=error_rate>5% (5 alerts in 60s). Auto-attach runbook: /runbooks/inference-prod/high-error-rate

pagerbot: Routing note: alerts routed to service="inference-prod-contractors" (schedule=temp-night-cover, override=true) — auto-escalation enabled

maria: @pagerbot that looks wrong. contractors should never receive prod P1s. who applied temp-night-cover? :exclamation:

devon: I was on rotation earlier and didn't get a page. confirmed contractors' rota got the storm.

tom: seeing multiple ACKs from contractor accounts in PD. contractors are acknowledging but they don't have access to prod runbooks. not ideal.

ops-manager: I see a sticky override applied by svc-admin yesterday to cover a deployment window. it should've been cleared this morning but didn't. investigating why the override persisted.

maria: can we stop pages to contractors now and reroute to inference-core-oncall? customers are experiencing 500s.

kai: prepping manual reroute. running PD command: ``/pd reroute --thread 1761112222 --from inference-prod-contractors --to inference-core-oncall --suppress contractors``

rotation-sync-bot: Schedule sync report: policy temp-night-cover flagged as "sticky" due to failed cleanup job (cleanup-run: 2024-11-01 03:12Z exit code 1).

pagerbot: Reroute executed. new routing: inference-core-oncall. suppressing notifications to inference-prod-contractors for 30m.

maria: test page in 45s to validate route. tagging @devon who should receive.

incident-bot: Test page -> target=inference-core-oncall fired.

devon: Received test page and ACKed. I'm taking ownership and will triage immediate customer impact.

maria: TL;DR of current state: routing fix applied, contractors suppressed, core oncall owns. root cause appears to be a manual sticky override that wasn't auto-cleared due to cleanup job failure.

devon: Initial triage: error spike due to KV cache thrash after a bad routing rollout earlier; exact chain: rollout -> transient 5xx -> alert -> override applied earlier during maintenance -> override remained -> pages misrouted. Customers A & B saw degraded traffic (timeouts) for ~8 minutes before reroute.

tom: PagerDuty timeline: first alert 1761112222, 12 pages went to contractors, 2 pages went to core after manual reroute, total MTTR to correct routing ~9 minutes.

maria: Immediate mitigation actions taken: 1) suppressed contractor rota, 2) manual reroute to core, 3) test page confirmed, 4) owner assigned (devon).

ops-manager: Longer-term action items we should spin up from this thread:
- disallow sticky overrides without expiry via policy in routing service
- add CI gate that rejects overrides older than 1h unless explicitly renewed
- fix cleanup-run flakiness (rotate creds and add retries)
- add an alert when a manual override persists >30m

kai: will open a platform ticket (PLAT-4567) for the cleanup-run + policy changes. assigning to infra-sre and routing team.

maria: Customer comms: SRE to draft incident banner for affected customers, list impacted services, and include ETA for postmortem. devon please collect request IDs and sample traces from the window.

devon: Captured logs and request IDs, uploading to the incident artifact bucket now. ETA 20m.

maria: thanks everyone. once PLAT-4567 exists and initial customer banner is out, we'll close this thread and move to postmortem. adding follow-ups to #incidents-retrospective. :thumbsup:

rotation-sync-bot: Cleanup job retriggered (attempt 2) — success. sticky flag cleared for temp-night-cover.

ops-manager: confirmed cleanup cleared. leaving suppress window for contractors for 30m to avoid noise.

maria: Last check: any outstanding actions we need to do in the next hour?

tom: I'll create the postmortem skeleton with timeline and attach logs from PD.

maria: Perfect. closing thread once postmortem link posted. Good catch, everyone.
